title: I really enjoyed this...
text: I really enjoyed this ghost tour in Barcelona! I went with my mom, who initially thought it was going to be cheesy, but she ended up enjoying it just as much as I did. The tour was filled with fascinating history, and we explored parts of the city that I probably wouldn’t have visited on my own, especially at night. It was a little longer than expected, but definitely worth it. A great way to experience a different side of Barcelona!
author: Venice_A

title: More than just a ghost tour!
text:
We absolutely loved this ghost tour! Our tour guide was one of the highlights — he was incredibly funny, lively, personable, and informative. He did such a great job bringing Barcelona’s streets and history to life through all the stories he shared.

I especially loved the way he told the stories, including the cliffhangers that kept us wanting to know what happened next. The questions he would ask at the end of each story made the tour feel interactive and kept us engaged the entire time.
